newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria needs adjustments in 1997 budget - Klima.
newsitem.headline: Austria needs adjustments in 1997 budget - Klima.

text.p: Austrian Chancellor Viktor Klima said on Tuesday the government needed to make some adjustments in order to reach its 1997 budget target and guarantee qualification for Europe's planned single currency.

"We have not achieved our targets for 1997 completely. Some adjustments will be necessary. But with adjustments we will reach our budget goal for 1997," Klima told a news conference after coalition budget talks in Rust, outside Vienna.
He declined to comment on how big the gap in the 1997 budget was. Austrian media have speculated the government is facing a budget shortfall of around six billion schillings this year.
Klima said the government was determined to keep the budget deficit below three percent of GDP in 1998 and 1999, in accordance with Maastricht rules.
"Our 1998 and 1999 budgets are very ambitious. We have set ourselves the task of keeping the overall budget deficit below three percent," he said.
The cabinet is expected to approve Finance Minister Hannes Farnleitner's budget proposals on July 22. Parliament should give its rubber stamp in September. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
